title: Quantum coherent dynamics in photosynthetic protein complexes
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,1089-1130
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00948K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ajay Jha, Fulu Zheng, Zihui Liu, Shaul Mukamel, Michael Thorwart, R. J. Dwayne Miller, Hong-Guang Duan
This review critically explores quantum coherence and dissipation in photosynthetic protein complexes, revealing how system–bath interactions, rather than long-lived coherence, govern robust and efficient downhill energy transfer.
